verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.ramp.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 as a machine-readable index. The index tells agents to fetch plain-text /llms-guides/*.txt files instead of JavaScript-shell HTML pages, and it also offers /llms-api.txt, /llms-full.txt, a canonical OpenAPI schema and automation recommendations. Further probes confirm the OpenAPI document parses with 174 paths and that an unauthenticated Developer docs MCP server answers live, giving agents both static and tool-based docs access.
